text: Want to understand the Arabic you hear every day, and speak it back?
One path: a reading starter, then twelve units, from greetings to hobbies.
Each step takes five to ten minutes. Meet new words, hear a conversation, learn one grammar idea, practise, then speak.
In the early units, you build sentences from word tiles. Later on, you type them yourself.
And رَفِيق brings every word back for review: after a day, then two, four, eight, so it sticks.
Want something specific? Step off the path, into Practise.
Drill twenty-one common verbs in three tenses, and the joining words that link your ideas.
Or play the spelling bee: hear a word, then spell it in Arabic.
Go further with Complete: real-life scenes, from the airport to the masjid.
Type your own replies, and رَفِيق names the mistake, like mixing up masculine and feminine, then helps you fix it.
And get a review built from the mistakes you keep making.
One path to follow, and practice whenever you want more. A few minutes a day.
Start your first lesson free at رَفِيق arabic dot com.
